shipped_rows.title_o: Enhanced recall of disgusting relative to frightening photographs is not due to organisation

blind_target.evidence_quote: However, because we did not replicate the mnemonic advantage of disgust, subsequent experiments were concerned with testing the replicability of this effect.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Because metamemorial judgments sometimes eliminate memory effects, participants in Experiment 2 did not make such judgments. Even so, the effect did not replicate. The disgust advantage was ultimately replicated in Experiment 3, where participants completed a secondary task at encoding.
